reason: Integrates multiple local coding-platform API keys and OAuth logins into DeepSeek Harness by reading credential stores and environment variables, with documented token-refresh side effects.

summaries.zh: 将本地 Claude、Codex、Grok、Gemini、OpenCode 等平台的 API 密钥和 OAuth 登录信息导入 DeepSeek Harness。
summaries.en: Imports local API keys and OAuth logins from Claude, Codex, Grok, Gemini, OpenCode, and related tools into DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Reads local credential files, environment variables, and macOS Keychain entries
Imports API keys and OAuth credentials into DeepSeek Harness
May refresh OAuth tokens and affect sign-in state of source CLI tools
